target_customer: General contractors and MEP and trade subcontractors doing estimating, bidding and purchasing
problem: Pre-construction buying is manual: takeoffs from drawings, bid leveling, contract review and invoice checks eat estimator time. FlowManual automates them with an estimating chat that links answers back to source PDF pages.
business_model: B2B SaaS with a free starting tier; paid pricing not found

founders.name: David Shijoon Bae
founders.background_notes: YC page describes the founders as Harvard dropouts and engineers.

founders.name: Michael Lin
education: Harvard (per launch post); research at UC Santa Cruz
founders.background_notes: Co-authored a paper submitted to IEEE IV 2025 per YC page; intern project figures are self-reported.

competitors.name: Togal.AI
competitors.traction_then: 4.8 of 5 from 60 verified G2 reviews per a comparison page

competitors.name: Beam AI (Attentive.ai)
competitors.traction_then: Expanded platform April 2026 delivering completed takeoffs

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading construction drawings and specs reliably with LLMs and vision, and linking results to source pages, is demanding but proven by competitors.

defensibility.rationale: Estimating workflows and cost data can lock in users, but several takeoff vendors already exist and the product is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Construction software players were acquiring AI startups in 2026 per industry newsletters. No outcome for FlowManual known.

market_need_then: Industry coverage in 2026 notes AI entering bidding workflows and a reported $124.5M raised by six AI planning and procurement startups in Q4 2025 (investor commentary).

identity.logo: Logo files referenced on site; not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Craft focused: Every sheet read. Every line priced. Built for the builders of America.

branding.brand_signature: Every sheet read. Every line priced.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name and a crisp tagline, but searches only return other Flow brands and nothing about FlowManual's brand.

outcome_analysis: FlowManual is a Summer 2026 YC company of two young engineers entering AI construction estimating, a space with established takeoff vendors. An August 2026 article describes a live product without public customers. No outcome news and no verified funding round were found, so it is too early to judge.
notes: Funding conflicts: founder profile says $500K from YC a month after starting, YesPress says a $130K seed in June 2026, Dealroom lists $125K. Only the YC standard deal is plausible; none verified, none recorded. First flowmanual.com fetch was rate limited by the tool safety check; second attempt succeeded. Education for Lin partly from launch post. Completeness pass: one round recorded from CB Insights only (convertible note, 500K USD total, no exact date, Y Combinator), which matches the YC standard deal. It rests on a single database. YesPress 130K seed (June 2026) and Dealroom 125K seed conflict and are not recorded.
